measurement_criteria_source: H&M How to Measure Guide (Chest over fullest bust, Waist at narrowest point, Low Hip around fullest part, Inside leg from crotch to floor)
range_rule: Assignment specification: Use lower number wherever size chart gives a range (e.g. 78-82 -> 78, 64-66 -> 64, 83-87 -> 83)

source_breakdown.chart_source: Directly extracted from user-provided H&M size chart screenshot (SIZE GUIDE - DRESSES, JUMPSUITS ETC. / REGULAR XXS-S).

ease_allowances_cm.rationale: Soft stretch jersey bodycon dress (89% poly / 11% elastane, 35% weft stretch) is drafted at its flat unstretched rest dimensions (flat chest width 28.7 cm -> 57.4 cm circumference for XS; negative ease of -20.6 cm in flat state vs 78 cm body). On a human XS body (78 cm), the fabric elongates elastically by 35.9% (~36%), matching the fabric's 35% weft stretch limit. On the provided SMPL-X avatar (89.2 cm bust), it requires 55.4% elongation, exceeding the fabric limit and reflecting an avatar sizing discrepancy (M/L body on XS garment).

length_specifications_cm.rationale: H&M size chart lists body measurements and inside leg rather than garment length. 118.0 cm provides an ankle-grazing maxi dress length corresponding to H&M catalog imagery. Back is +2.0 cm longer to accommodate dorsal thoracic curvature and buttocks curvature.

shoulder_specifications_cm.rationale: Narrow tank shoulder straps (~3.0 cm width) with outer strap span 23.5 cm measured directly from flat studio photography.
